name: Ensure deployer sshd config
description: Idempotently writes /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/proxvex.conf on the PVE host with relaxed MaxStartups so concurrent SSH from clone-driven self-upgrade doesn't trigger sshd's 'Not allowed at this time' rejection. Runs on every proxvex install/upgrade/reconfigure so existing deployments self-heal on the next life-cycle operation.
